page.overview:
Who is Guo Xun?

Guo Xun was born during the later life of Avatar Kyoshi. As a child, she idolized the Avatar, who supported Guo Xun's family taking the throne with the sacred duty to protect Omashu. When she became queen, she wholeheartedly embraced the political structure the Avatar had helped create. On her part, the queen found most of Jialun's actions to be cheap and selfish, thinking him insecure in his power for weakening the standing of those who had nothing to begin with, such as the Earth Sages.

During her rule, the Western Kingdom Trading Company was an influential force in Omashu. Eventually, the company requested permission to explore a remote Fire Island as ancient texts indicated that the location harbored a source of great power. Guo Xun denied the request, as the Fire Island was within Fire Nation territory and she wanted to avoid an international conflict. However, company researchers Yuming and Qixia disobeyed the monarch and ventured to Lambak Island in 66 BG, indeed becoming embroiled in a violent dispute that even involved Avatar Roku.

The researchers and their mercenaries were subsequently returned to Omashu to stand trial. When the company members shared their discovery of a special, spirit-infused metal with Guo Xun, however, the queen spared them from punishment. Prince Sozin of the Fire Nation began to grow concerned that Guo Xun had learned that Lambak Island's special ore could be used as a flux for making very high-quality steel. Sozin tried to spy on Omashu's queen through Ta Min, a new Fire Nation emissary that he sent as a diplomat, though the noblewoman proved to be an unreliable agent.

In 63 BG, Ta Min revealed that Earth King Jialun had plotted overthrow Guo Xun, with one of her ministers, Huaji, planning to betray her. After this revelation, the rivalry between Guo Xun and Jialun further escalated.
